gloss.en: Chinese startup Moonshot will require licenses for its Kimi K3 model, while Anthropic settles with authors over data use—two sides of the same access-and-rights coin.
gloss.zh: 中国初创公司Moonshot要求对Kimi K3模型获得许可，而Anthropic与作者达成数据使用和解——同一枚准入与权利硬币的两面。

why_now.en: You follow LLM and AI: today's dual news on licensing and copyright settlement shapes how you get access to models.
why_now.zh: 你关注LLM和AI：今日关于许可和版权和解的双重新闻影响着你获取模型的方式。

phrase.en: Apple regains top spot over Nvidia
phrase.zh: 苹果重夺市值榜首超越英伟达

phrase.en: Verizon $1B dark fiber for Google AI
phrase.zh: Verizon 10亿美元暗光纤用于谷歌AI

gloss.en: Verizon's $1B dark fiber deal for Google data centers and Apple's market cap surge over Nvidia both signal that AI's physical backbone is where the real value lies.
gloss.zh: Verizon为谷歌数据中心投入10亿美元暗光纤交易，苹果市值超越英伟达，都表明AI的物理基础架构才是真正价值所在。

why_now.en: You follow AI: these two business moves today underline the infrastructure race behind every AI model you use.
why_now.zh: 你关注AI：今日这两项商业举措凸显了你所用每个AI模型背后的基础设施竞赛。

phrase.en: AI virtual patient for bad news
phrase.zh: AI虚拟病人用于告知坏消息

gloss.en: Two new papers explore AI-driven virtual patients for breaking bad news and AI decision support for autism assessment, pushing simulation into sensitive clinical contexts.
gloss.zh: 两篇新论文探索了用于告知坏消息的AI驱动虚拟病人和自闭症评估的AI决策支持，将模拟推进到敏感的临床情境。

why_now.en: You follow LLM and HCI: these two arXiv papers from today show how LLMs are being embedded in high-stakes human interactions.
why_now.zh: 你关注LLM和人机交互：今日这两篇arXiv论文展示了大语言模型如何被嵌入高风险人际交互中。
